terms.LIVE: provider-confirmed active play is strongest evidence; timing alone is inference
terms.PREGAME: event is within its sport-specific pregame window
terms.FINAL: event is complete; retain only if evidence does not contradict completion
terms.POSTPONED: scheduled event moved or delayed; seek authoritative replacement time
terms.HALFTIME: football/basketball/similar mid-game interval; event remains active
terms.OVERTIME: extra playing period; extends the live window
terms.QUALIFYING: racing session used to determine starting order
terms.PRACTICE: racing preparation session; not the race itself
terms.SHOOTOUT: hockey tiebreaking phase following overtime when applicable
